div.div: دِفَقٌّ (assumed tropical:) Quick, swift, or fleet; applied to a hecamel; (JK, S, K;) as also ↓ أَدْفَقُ : (JK:) and so, applied to a she-camel, دِفَقَّةٌ (JK) and ↓ دِفَاقٌ , (JK, S, K,) which is likewise applied to a hecamel, (JK, TA,) and ↓ دُفَاقٌ (K) and ↓ دَفُوقٌ and ↓ دَفْقَآءُ (JK, TA) and ↓ دَيْفَقٌ (JK, K) and ↓ دِفِقَّى . (TA.) (assumed tropical:) A camel going in the manner termed دِفِقَّى; as also ↓ دِفَاقٌ . (K.) (assumed tropical:) And, applied to a horse, Fleet, or swift; as also ↓ دِفقٌّ : and so, applied to a mare, دِفَقَّةٌ and ↓ دَفوُقٌ and ↓ دِفَاقٌ and ↓ دِفَقَّى and ↓ دِفِقَّى . (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
